description: Post-Phase-6 structural ceiling with reviewed production additions for the internal intelligence portals. The total-file ceiling includes the Entity & DBA Resolution route from Issue #38, the Occupational Exposure & Service Fit Matrix route from Issue #40, the Company Live Intelligence files from Issue #42, Workers’ Compensation Source Coverage from Issue #44, Defense Base Act Intelligence from Issue #46, Source Governance from Issue #48, Unified Employer Workflow from Issue #50, the public-source employer brief from Issue #52, Location Overlap from PR #79, the two focused Neon-backed DBA Data Hub production files from PR #91, the cumulative 2001–2024 DBA workspace added from user-provided redacted workbooks, the standalone public-source tools, the dedicated AOR multi-source workspace, the CourtListener content-enrichment route, the focused public API repair router, the dedicated International Crisis Group CrisisWatch RSS adapter replacing the former CFR link-only conflict reference, the AOR source-policy route that retires ACLED from the active product, the bounded server-side state-geometry proxy supporting the clickable State Agencies map, and the bounded LangSearch route that powers live Competitor, Federal Agency, State Agency, and FMCSA/DOT medical-exam research instead of preloaded cards or carrier lookup. SEC Filings, Organizational Chart, and DBA Data Hub remain standalone navigation destinations; the two global map workspaces remain portal-only destinations. Data Profiles, Company Library, company-file detail routes, frontend pages, API clients, and verification artifacts have been removed from the active repository. The two reviewed component-level style blocks are the existing app-shell effects and the route-scoped Location Overlap map effects. Duplicate files, generated artifacts, invalid coordinates, extra app shells, and additional injected-style files remain prohibited.
